text: Piercing lets air into the cheese, and the blue mould needs that oxygen to grow along the needle channels.

steps.note: Blue mould is added to the milk or curd, or settles from the cave air.
The cheese is salted dry instead, as an alternative to brining.
Holes are pierced into the cheese with needles, which lets air in.
The cheese is ripened while the blue mould grows along the needle channels.
